summary: ArcelorMittal filed a Form 6-K on May 27, 2026, attaching a press release regarding a routine share transaction notification by a Designated Person (director or executive officer) under EU Market Abuse Regulation. The filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or other special situation. It is a standard disclosure of insider share dealing, required under securities law, with no deal terms, premium, or structural change. No board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is referenced. This is not a special situation; it is a routine current report.
